decisions.statement: A sale is held under the sale id the game gave the sale.
A sale names the item sold and the quantity of the item.
A sale names the buyer and the guild the sale went through.
A sale names the price paid and the tax taken out of the price.
Every field of a sale may be missing.
The payload names the account the sales were captured under.
Nothing here has code that runs.

definition: the shape one sale through a guild store takes, held under an id of its own
